description: Mouse Dock11 MGI phenotype statements and a summary of model-system evidence for ADMIDX
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r=requests.get("https://www.alliancegenome.org/api/gene/MGI:1923224/phenotypes",params={"limit":100},timeout=90).json()
rows=[]
for x in r.get("results",[]):
    pm=[p.get("curie") or p.get("primaryExternalId") for p in (x.get("pubmedPublications") or [])]
    alle=sorted({(pa.get("displayName") or pa.get("id") or "") for pa in (x.get("primaryAnnotations") or [])})
    rows.append({"phenotypeStatement":x.get("phenotypeStatement"),
                 "allele/genotype":"; ".join(a for a in alle if a)[:70],
                 "refs":", ".join(str(p) for p in pm if p)})
md=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates()
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",95)
print("=== Mouse Dock11 phenotype annotations (MGI via Alliance), n =", len(md), "===")
print(md.to_string(index=False))

# Summary figure: evidence available per model system
models=pd.DataFrame([
 ("Mouse\nDock11 KO", 3, "T-cell hyperactivation,\nNFATc1 nuclear translocation\n(PMID 37342957)"),
 ("Zebrafish\ndock11 KO", 3, "anaemia, aberrant\nerythrocyte morphology\n(PMID 37342957)"),
 ("Patient T cells /\nB-LCL", 3, "no filopodia, abnormal\nconfined migration, low CDC42-GTP\n(PMID 36952639, 37342957)"),
 ("Patient platelets", 2, "abnormal ultrastructure\nand spreading (PMID 36952639)"),
 ("shRNA knockdown\nhealthy MoDC / T cells", 2, "recapitulates protrusion and\nmigration defect (PMID 36952639)"),
 ("Cryo-EM full-length\nDOCK11 + CDC42", 3, "4 structures 22VD/22VE/22VF/22VG,\n3.80-6.07 A (PMID 42837459)"),
 ("IMPC Dock11 KO\n(hemizygous)", 1, "only increased kidney weight\np=7.7e-05, no immune call"),
], columns=["model","strength","detail"])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,5.2))
cols={3:"#1a5276",2:"#2e86c1",1:"#aab7b8"}
y=np.arange(len(models))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,models.strength,color=[cols[s] for s in models.strength],height=0.6)
for yy,m,d,s in zip(y,models.model,models.detail,models.strength):
    ax.text(-0.08,yy,m,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8.5)
    ax.text(s+0.06,yy,d,ha="left",va="center",fontsize=7.4)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(-0.05,5.6); ax.set_xticks([1,2,3])
ax.set_xticklabels(["weak /\nno disease link","supportive","recapitulates\nhuman feature"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("strength of evidence linking the model to ADMIDX")
ax.set_title("Experimental systems for DOCK11 deficiency and what each one reproduces",fontsize=11)
ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
